operators.name: custom_batchnorm2d

parameters.name: input
parameters.layout: torch.strided (contiguous or non-contiguous as produced by previous op)

semantics: Implements torch.nn.BatchNorm2d.forward for both training and eval modes.
If training is true, uses batch statistics (mean/var over N,H,W per channel) and updates running stats; if false, uses provided running_mean/running_var.
Normalization: y = (input - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * weight + bias (if weight/bias are not None, otherwise y = (input - mean) / sqrt(var + eps)).
Broadcast along channel dimension C; other dimensions preserved.
Input must be at least 2D, with channel dimension at index 1; output shape matches input shape.
No in-place modification; returns a new tensor.

operators.name: custom_gelu
semantics: Implements torch.nn.GELU with approximate='none': output = input * 0.5 * (1 + erf(input / sqrt(2))).
Elementwise operation preserving shape, dtype, and device.
No in-place modification; returns a new tensor.
BatchNorm2d in eval mode (training=False) uses running_mean and running_var with eps=1e-05.
Normalizes input x of shape [16,3,1024,512] along channel dimension (dim=1) using affine parameters weight and bias.
Output shape [16,3,1024,512], dtype float32, device cuda.
GELU with approximate='none': elementwise x * 0.5 * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2))).
Input and output shape [16,3,1024,512], dtype float32, device cuda.
Final output is the result after GELU.
